candidates.classification: New bounded source-derived admitted-duration and inertial polynomial operation case; actual extreme tuning and transition reachability remain open.
candidates.trace: PositiveAnimationDuration admits any finite strictly positive f32 through AnimationElapsed; the PoseBufferConfig validator only checks the two stated range relationships and does not bound inertial_blend_seconds. Assuming other config fields valid, f32::MAX is admitted and can be installed as the shared validated runtime snapshot. During a plan change on an already displayed, nonculled authored rig, a joint with finite one-metre translation offset and zero relative velocity enters QuinticChannel::new with that blend. The duration squared overflows to infinity, a0 becomes signed zero, and a0 * t2 produces NaN under IEEE floating-point arithmetic. The checked duration remains finite, so the constructor can return Ok with nonfinite polynomial coefficients. The prepared per-joint capture then stores both channels; before the duration expires the offset evaluation can return NaN. If the corresponding entity transform is available, apply_pose_buffers writes the resulting translation without a finite check.
candidates.symbolic_example: Take finite unit translation offset, zero relative linear velocity, identical finite rotations with zero relative angular velocity, and blend f32::MAX; all other config fields valid. At elapsed zero or an ordinary finite positive delta, duration is not expired. This is symbolic source-level reasoning, not an installed configuration, executed float computation, animation, render or observed nonfinite output.
candidates.guards_and_limits: Shipped combat YAML uses 0.2 seconds. Already-finished zero channels are intentionally skipped; inactive rigs snap to the target rather than creating a displayed offset. Overshoot shortening applies only when v0 < 0 and x0 > 0; the zero-velocity example avoids it. Frozen rigs skip application, missing joint entities/transform queries skip writing, and checked elapsed arithmetic can reject nonfinite time. The prior prepare-both-channels-before-assignment guard remains effective for errors, but does not check coefficient finiteness. Actual authored extreme config, required plan transition, visual behavior and platform floating implementation remain unobserved. Client presentation only; no tactical or fatigue change claimed.
candidates.connected_repair: Preserve the shared authoritative config boundary and ensure the entire polynomial channel and resulting pose are finite before retained state or native transform publication; reject or safely compute any unrepresentable blend at its owning admission/operation. Preserve ordinary transition continuity, exact zero/rest handling, interruption behavior and existing culling/physics ownership. Avoid local tuning fallbacks.
candidates.later_acceptance: After separate implementation and product-validation authorization, cover normal blend and interruptions, extreme finite duration with nonzero offset, zero channel, finite output and frozen/physics paths with the project-required native diagnostic when applicable.

existing_finding_connections.trace: Current client README says active sparse anchor blending is linear with phase. Resolver passes sampled authored clip time plus a retained physical locomotion phase for WalkContact/RunContact; weighted clips preserve that option, and current pose sampling selects sparse locomotion when the option is present. The sparse kernel computes t*t*(3-2*t). At authored quarter-segment fraction t=1/4, exact rational smoothstep is 5/32 while linear is 1/4. The README statement and local sampler differ under those stated coordinates.
existing_finding_connections.guards_and_limits: The resolver can use an independently calibrated phase mapping before converting to clip time; thus an authored phase example does not prove visible physical-phase easing or actual ordinary locomotion output. Asset admission, complete calibration composition, current capture policy and intended documentation-versus-behavior choice remain open. Source tests checking boundaries and midpoint were read only.
